text_block_list.text:
Invited by Maruzensky, I came to the game 
center.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, thank you for coming along 
with me all the way out here.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, thank you for accompanying 
me all the way out here.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the mood to go for a drive today, 
but unfortunately, I've got Tacchan in the 
shop for maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"So... modern games are practically 
lifelike, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm actually pretty good at racing games! 
I used to play them a lot with my mom when 
I was a kid!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So today, let's make that in-game car roar 
with my killer driving skills!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Kyaah, I-I'm slipping... Wait, this isn't 
right... Eeeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, listen to me... Ah, the wall! The 
waaaall... Aaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"N-No way... It's so realistic it's making 
my head spin...! This isn't the racing 
game I know...!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"It has to be Tacchan after all... Please, 
come back soon!!"
